sections.content:
Key finding: Clicks on the left stem (36,8), (39,8), etc. produce no change at all. Clicks on the right stem (36,49), (36,39), (36,54) toggle the top dash. So the left stem is not toggleable?? But the left bar is B and the right bar is w...
Wait, maybe the left stem is toggleable but the click coordinates are wrong. Left stem dashes: (35-37, col 8) vertical 3x1; (39, 7-9) horizontal; (41-43, 8); (45, 7-9); (47-49, 8). Click (36,8) should hit the first dash. No change.
Hmm, or maybe the left group's marks are "locked" because the left box is selected (blue border)? Or the left stem is already in the "correct" state, and only incorrect marks are clickable?
Interesting hypothesis: only marks that are not in the goal state are toggleable! Left stem = w is the goal (locked/correct), right stem top dash = w is not the goal → toggleable. Then the goal would be: left stem w, left bar ???, right stem ???, right bar ???.
But the left bar is B — is it toggleable? Let me test: click (33,8). If it toggles to w, then the left bar is not in the goal state.
Also, the right stem top dash is currently B (I toggled it). If B is not the goal, it should still be toggleable back to w.
And the right bar is w — test (33,39).
Hypothesis A: goal = left group (bar B, stem w) + right group (bar w, stem w)?? I.e., the right stem should be w. But I set the right stem top to B... if B is wrong, it's still toggleable.
Hypothesis B: goal = all w: left bar B is wrong → toggleable; right stem B is wrong → toggleable; everything else is w and locked.
Test: click (33,8) [left bar], (33,39) [right bar], (36,39) [right stem top, currently B].
Expected results under Hypothesis B: (33,8) toggles B→w; (33,39) toggles w→B?? No wait — under "only wrong marks are toggleable," the right bar w is correct → locked. Under "everything is toggleable," it toggles.
Let me run the three test clicks and observe.
